question: What should we do with old plastic bottles instead of throwing them in the ocean? ♻️
explanation: Awesome! When we recycle plastic bottles, they can be melted down and made into brand new things instead of hurting sea animals! ♻️
hint: Look at the green symbol with three arrows.

question: Which type of bag is the best for shopping to help our planet? 🛍️
explanation: Great job! A cloth bag can be washed and reused many times, which reduces plastic waste! 🎒
hint: It is made of fabric and can be washed.

question: How can we save water while brushing our teeth? 🪥
explanation: Super! Turning off the tap while brushing saves a lot of clean water every day! 🛑
hint: Stop the water flow until you need to rinse.

question: What is the best way to use leftover vegetable scraps? 🥕
explanation: Awesome! Vegetable scraps can turn into compost, which is healthy food for our plants! 🌱
hint: It turns into natural fertilizer for soil.

question: How should we travel short distances to keep the air clean? 🚲
explanation: Great job! Walking or riding a bicycle keeps you healthy and does not create any smoke! 🚲
hint: Use your own energy to move.

question: What should you do with clothes that are too small for you? 👕
explanation: Super! Giving old clothes to someone who needs them is a wonderful way to reuse! 👕
hint: Give them to younger children or charity.

question: How can we save paper while writing or drawing? 📝
explanation: Awesome! Using both sides of the paper helps save many trees from being cut down! 📝
hint: Do not leave the back blank.

question: What is the best way to light up a room during the daytime? ☀️
explanation: Great job! Sunlight is free and opening windows saves electricity during the day! 🪟
hint: Let the natural sunlight come inside.

question: What must we do when we are the last person to leave a room? 🚪
explanation: Super! Turning off the lights and fans saves valuable electricity! 🔌
hint: Press the button to stop the power.

question: What should we do when a toy breaks? 🧸
explanation: Awesome! Fixing things instead of throwing them away is a smart way to reuse! 🛠️
hint: Use glue or ask an adult for help to repair it.

question: Why is it important to plant more trees? 🌳
explanation: Great job! Trees clean the air and give us fresh oxygen to breathe! 🌬️
hint: They act like the Earth's lungs.

question: What is a smart way to use rainwater? 🌧️
explanation: Super! Collecting rainwater is called water harvesting, and we can use it to water plants! 🪣
hint: Save it in containers for later.

question: How can we protect the natural homes of wild animals? 🐅
explanation: Awesome! Forests are the natural homes of many animals, so we must protect them! 🌲
hint: Save the places with lots of trees.

question: How can we help the little birds outside our homes? 🐦
explanation: Great job! Giving birds seeds and water helps them survive, especially in extreme weather! 🌻
hint: Give them something yummy to eat.

question: What is the best way to help ocean animals like turtles? 🐢
explanation: Super! A clean beach means less trash gets into the ocean, keeping marine animals safe! 🏖️
hint: Pick up garbage near the sea.

question: Which bulb is better to use because it saves electricity? 💡
explanation: Awesome! LED bulbs use very little electricity and last a long time! 💡
hint: These are modern, bright, and cool to touch.

question: What kind of lunchbox is best for school every day? 🍱
explanation: Great job! A steel lunchbox can be washed and reused for years, creating zero waste! 🍱
hint: It is made of strong metal.

question: What should we do with dry, fallen leaves in the garden? 🍂
explanation: Super! Dry leaves make excellent natural compost to help other plants grow! 🍂
hint: Let them break down in the soil.

question: How should a good global citizen behave? 🌍
explanation: Awesome! A global citizen cares about all people, animals, and nature around the world! 🤝
hint: Show love and kindness to the whole world.

question: Which of these is a clean energy source that does not cause pollution? ☀️
explanation: Great job! Solar energy from the sun is perfectly clean and never runs out! ☀️
hint: It shines in the sky during the day.

question: What can we do with empty glass jam jars? 🍓
explanation: Super! Reusing glass jars to store spices or pulses is a brilliant way to recycle at home! 🫙
hint: Wash them and put other things inside.

question: What should you do if you see a leaking tap? 💧
explanation: Awesome! Fixing a leaky tap stops clean water from wasting away drop by drop! 🔧
hint: Call a plumber or tell an adult immediately.

question: Where should you put your empty chips packets after a picnic? 🏞️
explanation: Great job! Always use a dustbin so that beautiful parks and nature stay clean! 🗑️
hint: Look for a proper waste container.

question: What should you do with books after you finish reading them? 📚
explanation: Super! Sharing books means more kids get to read without cutting down new trees for paper! 📚
hint: Give them to someone else to enjoy.

question: Which bathing method saves the most water? 🛁
explanation: Awesome! Using a bucket lets you know exactly how much water you are using, saving a lot! 🪣
hint: Fill a container instead of standing under running water.

question: What is a wonderful activity to do on Earth Day? 🌍
explanation: Great job! Planting a baby tree (sapling) is a fantastic way to celebrate and help the Earth! 🌱
hint: Put a new baby plant in the soil.

question: How should we treat our local rivers and lakes? 🌊
explanation: Super! Clean rivers provide safe drinking water and a healthy home for fish! 🌊
hint: Do not add any dirt or waste to the water.

question: How can we help animals in the hot summer? ☀️
explanation: Awesome! Keeping bowls of fresh water helps thirsty birds and stray animals stay cool! 💧
hint: Provide a cool drink for them outside.

question: What is a creative way to reuse old newspapers? 📰
explanation: Great job! Folding old newspapers into bags is a fun craft that reduces plastic use! 🛍️
hint: Fold them to carry light items.

question: How can we make the air inside our homes cleaner? 🏠
explanation: Super! Indoor plants naturally filter the air and make our homes look beautiful! 🪴
hint: Bring nature inside in small pots.

question: What should we do with leftover edible food? 🍞
explanation: Awesome! Feeding safe leftover food to animals like cows or dogs prevents food waste! 🐄
hint: Share it with hungry street friends.

question: What is an eco-friendly way to wrap a birthday gift? 🎁
explanation: Great job! Using colorful comic pages from old newspapers is a cool and green way to wrap gifts! 📰
hint: Reuse paper with printing on it.

question: What should we do with old, dead batteries? 🔋
explanation: Super! Batteries have chemicals, so we must drop them in special electronic recycling bins! 🔋
hint: Do not mix them with regular trash.

question: How should we observe wild animals when we visit a forest? 🦌
explanation: Awesome! Watching quietly from far away respects the animals' space and keeps everyone safe! 🔭
hint: Use binoculars and stay quiet.

question: What must we be careful about when visiting dry forests? 🌲
explanation: Great job! We must never light fires in dry forests to protect trees and animal homes! 🌲
hint: Keep flames away from dry leaves.

question: How can we help important insects like bees and butterflies? 🦋
explanation: Super! Flowers provide nectar for bees and butterflies, which helps nature grow! 🌺
hint: Grow bright, blooming plants.

question: How can we take care of our public parks? 🏞️
explanation: Awesome! By not littering and protecting the plants, we keep parks beautiful for everyone! 🏞️
hint: Leave it as pretty as you found it.

question: What is the best way to wash a family vehicle? 🚗
explanation: Great job! A sponge and bucket use much less water than a constantly running hosepipe! 🪣
hint: Fill a container with soapy water.

question: Which transport is best for a group of kids going to school? 🚌
explanation: Super! A school bus carries many students together, which reduces traffic and pollution! 🚌
hint: The big yellow vehicle.

question: Which straw is the best choice for protecting the Earth? 🌍
explanation: Awesome! Steel straws can be washed and reused forever, saving turtles from plastic! 🥤
hint: It is made of shiny, washable metal.

question: What should you carry to avoid buying plastic water bottles? 💧
explanation: Great job! Carrying your own reusable bottle is the best way to stop plastic waste! 🚰
hint: Bring your own strong container from home.

question: Who are the Earth's best natural friends? 🌿
explanation: Super! Trees and plants are Earth's best friends because they give food, shade, and clean air! 🌳
hint: They have green leaves and roots.

question: What is best to use for cleaning the house floors? 🧹
explanation: Awesome! Natural cleaners like lemon and vinegar are safe for our water and soil! 🍋
hint: Items made from plants, not strong liquids.

question: How should we treat stray animals in our neighborhood? 🐕
explanation: Great job! Being kind and offering a little food shows true love for all living beings! 🥣
hint: Offer them a gentle meal.

question: What should you do after using a computer or tablet? 💻
explanation: Super! Shutting down electronics when not in use saves a lot of energy! 🔌
hint: Power it down completely.

question: What fun craft can you make with empty tin cans? 🥫
explanation: Awesome! Painting a can to hold your pencils is a super creative way to upcycle! ✏️
hint: A place to keep your desk tidy.

question: What is the best thing to add to garden soil to make it healthy? 🪴
explanation: Great job! Compost is natural plant food that makes the soil very rich and healthy! 🌱
hint: Use the natural mix of old leaves and vegetable peels.

question: How should we treat our beautiful Earth? 🌍
explanation: Super! Earth is our only home, so we must love, cherish, and protect it every day! 🌍
hint: Take good care of it.

question: What does a good global citizen do? 🌎
explanation: Awesome! A global citizen knows that helping the planet helps everyone in the world! 🤝
hint: Do good things for the whole world.

question: What kind of Earth should we leave for the future? 🌅
explanation: Great job! We must take care of the Earth today so it stays beautiful and healthy for tomorrow! 🌍
hint: A healthy and green home.
